name: Rosss S.p.A.
summary: Rosss S.p.A. provides metal shelving for offices, storages, warehouses, shops, and supermarkets primarily in Italy. The company offers heavy storage shelves, such as iron fist pallet racks, iron fist drive in shelves, dublez shelvings, sequoia cantilevers, mammuth super pallet racks, and tree cheese scalera. It also provides lightweight storage shelves, including unimondial hook shelving; Unimondial Galv, a galvanized hook shelving; Unizinc Easy, an interlocking shelving; and Train, a compactable shelf. In addition, the company offers Mecano, a mezzanine without welding; Ti-Abbraccio ergonomic check-out counters; and anti-seismic, self-supporting, and integrated systems. It also exports its products to approximately 50 countries. Rosss S.p.A. was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Florence, Italy.
